subject: Noventia implementation — lanes, owners, and go-live target
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@noventia.com>, procurement@noventia.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Noventia implementation — lanes, owners, and go-live target

Team — looping you in for the sales->CS handoff. Quick context: Noventia signed on 2/25 for a 12-month hosted + dedicated burst contract (estimated monthly token volume ~120M). They prioritize predictable latency for interactive triage flows and compliance controls (retention and audit logs).

Summary / asks from Sales:
- Go-live target: customer requested week of Mar 14 (soft target) — aim for Mar 15 as internal milestone.
- Scope for MVP: core text generation endpoints + per-customer prefix caching and SSO integration. Acceptance criteria: 95th pctl latency < 450ms for 512-token requests and a smoke test of 1,000 requests in the staging pool.
- Contract status: SOW attached (Noventia_SOW_v2.docx) — procurement expects to return the signed SOW by EOD 3/4.
- Known risks: customer requires private VPC peering for dedicated GPU pools (network approvals may add 2–3 business days). They will also need HSM-backed key storage for production service keys.

Owners (proposed):
- Primary CS owner: Monica Patel — overall activation owner and acceptance sign-off.
- Implementation lead: Tessa Morgan — day-to-day runbook and sprints.
- Escalation / quota ops: Ben Carter — will assist on quota increases and Dedicated capacity tweaks.

Pre-kickoff items for CS to confirm:
1) Confirm owners and preferred 60–90 minute kickoff time (we should schedule for next week if possible).
2) Confirm security POC at Noventia (IT contact).
3) Validate SSO approach (SAML or OIDC) and share IdP metadata if SAML.
4) Request for temporary API key for staging (I’ve attached a short temporary key file stub noventia_temp_api_key.txt — please rotate after test).

Links and attachments:
- HubSpot deal (DE-2027-093-NOV): https://hubspot.redwood/deals/DE-2027-093-NOV
- Draft MVP runbook (attached): mvp_runbook_v1.pdf
- SOW (attached): Noventia_SOW_v2.docx

Next steps: Monica/Tessa — can you confirm owners and a kickoff slot? Jane — thanks for partnering here; Monica will reach out with a kickoff invite once we lock time.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@noventia.com>
Cc: procurement@noventia.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Noventia implementation — lanes, owners, and go-live target

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the context and the clear asks.

I’ll take primary ownership of the activation and sign-off. Tessa — can you be the implementation lead as proposed? Ben — please stand by for quota/throughput questions.

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Mar 8 at 10:00 AM PT (60 minutes). If that conflicts with Noventia, we can shift to Wed afternoon. For the kickoff we’ll cover: intro/roles, SSO & network prerequisites, staging test plan, and a draft rollout timeline.

Pre-kickoff requests for Noventia (Jane / IT):
- IT contact for SSO & network (name, email, and approximate availability).
- Test IdP metadata if using SAML, or OIDC discovery URL.
- Any specific IP allow lists for the VPC peering timeframe.

I’ll create a Miro board for the implementation runbook and post a link to the Drive (will link to the HubSpot deal afterwards).

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
